title: Initiative Debt Ledger and SLI Recovery Simulation for Cross-Team Rollups
creator: Aisha Menon
description:
Problem: We lack a lightweight, auditable ledger that records initiative-level 'reliability debt' (work deferred that consumes future error budget) and a deterministic simulator that shows how proposed work or rollouts will affect SLI trajectories and pooled error budgets across teams. This makes prioritization and cross-team reallocation decisions ad-hoc during burn incidents.

Proposal: Build an Initiative Debt Ledger (IDL) and an SLI Recovery Simulation tool. IDL will capture retrospective debt entries and prospective commitments (e.g., feature rollout windows, planned experiments, seasonal spikes) tagged to initiatives/OKRs. The simulator will accept current SLI baselines, initiative debt entries, and proposed mitigations (canary limits, traffic shaping, caching toggles) and output projected SLI curves, error-budget consumption timelines, and recommended reallocation actions.

Why unique: Unlike single-team error-budget dashboards, this ticket focuses on a coordinated cross-team ledger + simulation that treats initiative work as first-class debt, enabling planned reallocation and pre-emptive throttling policies rather than emergency rollbacks.

Scope: PM surface and console integration (read/write IDL entries), CSV import/export for initiative debt, simulation API endpoint for engineering to integrate into rollout pipelines, and a simple visualization in Console showing projected SLI runway per initiative and recommended action pins.
acceptance_criteria: IDL schema designed and documented in Confluence with fields: initiative_id, owner_team, estimated_error_budget_cost, window_start, window_end, mitigation_flags, rationale, linked_prs
Console UI mockups for IDL entry and per-initiative runway visual created and reviewed by Design
Simulation API accepts a payload with current SLI baselines, list of IDL entries, and mitigation knobs and returns time-series projections and action recommendations
End-to-end demo: import sample CSV, run simulation for two concurrent initiatives, and produce recommended reallocation plan
Telemetry: simulation runs logged and surfaced to telemetry dashboard; 90th percentile simulation latency < 300ms for small payloads
success_metrics: Reduction in emergency rollback incidents attributable to cross-team conflicts by 30% in the following quarter
95% of simulated reallocation recommendations are actionable by SRE/plat teams (surveyed)
>75% of active initiatives have IDL entries within 2 weeks of kickoff
